limitations: Browser checks are scripted developer acceptance, not independent learner research or evidence of learning gains.
Source-recall gate and bounded repair are independently tested; final HTTP integration and real-model acceptance remain root-agent work.

practiceQuality.scope: One explicit non-NULL SQL phrase alias family plus Unicode/case/whitespace duplicates. Passing is not semantic validation.
practiceQuality.repair: One fresh repair prompt only after the narrow quality error. Frozen generator can make at most two model calls; repair adds one.
practiceQuality.verification: Mocked generation/repair calls and deterministic validators, including response-body cancellation/timeout; no real model performance claim.
